result.lint_fix:
In tools/lint_bank.py scan(), replace the three lines that test the lowercased `stem` with these checks on the original item.stem. The figure rule needs case to spot 'figure A':

TABLE_WORD = re.compile(r"\btables?\b", re.I)
FIGURE_WORD = re.compile(r"\b(?i:figures?)\b(?!\s+[A-Z]\b)|\b(?i:pictured|diagram)\b")   # 'figure A' names a shape; 'pictured' points at one
GRAPH_WORD = re.compile(r"\bgraphs?\b", re.I)
GRAPH_DEFINED = re.compile(r"\bgraphs?\s+of\b|\bgraphed\b", re.I)   # the graph is given in words
GRAPH_POINTED = re.compile(r"\bgraphs?\s+(?:shown|above|below|shows?)\b|\bshown\s+in\s+the\s+graph\b|\bgraphs?\s+of\b[^.?]*\b(?:is|are)\s+shown\b|\bfollowing\s+graphs\b", re.I)   # ...unless it then points at a picture

    if TABLE_WORD.search(item.stem) and not item.table: report("missing_table", item.stem)
    if FIGURE_WORD.search(item.stem) and not item.figure: report("missing_figure", item.stem)
    if not item.figure and GRAPH_WORD.search(item.stem) and (GRAPH_POINTED.search(item.stem) or not GRAPH_DEFINED.search(item.stem)):
        report("missing_graph", item.stem)

I checked this against all templates at seeds 0-49. missing_graph falls from 936 to 0. missing_figure falls from 7 false findings to 50 real ones (context.formula_solve). missing_table goes from 65 to 102, all real (le2.which_table 50, ovd.freq_choose 40, ineq.point_solution 12). A test harness in the scratchpad also asserts that the new rules still flag 'The graph shows...', 'The graph of y = f(x) is shown.', 'Which of the following graphs could be the graph of...', 'In the figure...', 'The glass pictured above...' and 'following frequency tables' when no visual is present. It asserts they do not flag 'the graph of y = 2x + 1', 'is graphed... of the graph?', 'Figure A and figure B', or a 'graph shows' stem that has a figure.
